newImagesNeeded.brief: Infant CPR, two-thumb encircling: both hands wrap the chest, thumbs side by side on the lower half of the breastbone just below the nipple line; down-arrow; replaces two-finger ep-tim-so-sinh.
Infant face-up along forearm, head lower than chest, rescuer gives chest thrust with heel of one hand on lower breastbone (no two fingers).
Toddler/preschooler leaning forward, adult behind and to the side supporting the chest, heel-of-hand back blow between shoulder blades.
Infant supine on firm surface, head in neutral (level) position, one hand on forehead, one fingertip lifting the chin; no hyperextension.
Adult presses a generic (unbranded) adrenaline auto-injector into the outer mid-thigh of a seated child, through trousers.
Adult on the bank reaching a pole/float to a child in a pond, staying out of the water.
Infant recovery position: baby cradled on side in adult's arms, head tilted slightly down.
Parent holding a cloth-wrapped ice pack on a toddler's forehead lump, child sitting alert.
Coin-shaped button battery next to a jar of honey and a 5 ml spoon; small '1+ tuổi' age cue as a shape, no baked-in text.
Adult switching off a wall breaker/main switch while a child lies near a socket; no contact with the child.
Child's forearm with raised pale-pink hives; parent photographing it with a phone. Use a range of skin tones.
A knocked-out tooth held by the crown being placed into a small cup of milk.
Child sitting upright using a blue reliever inhaler through a spacer (no mask) with a parent beside them.
Pictogram: wave with a small head and raised hand, error-soft circle, same style as icon-*.
Pictogram: figure lying on side (recovery position).
Pictogram: child head with a bump and small stars.
Pictogram: button battery and magnet.
Pictogram: plug/socket with lightning bolt.
Pictogram: bottle with droplet on a hand.
Pictogram: hand with raised dots (hives).
Pictogram: crying toddler face with blue lips.
Pictogram: tooth with a chip.
Pictogram: inhaler and lungs.

imageReviewNotes.issue: Shows two-finger compression low on the chest (technique removed by AHA 2025 and ERC 2025). Retire; replace with ep-tim-so-sinh-hai-ngon-cai.
Infant chest thrust with two fingers. Retire; replace with an-nguc-hai-ngon-cai.
Shows an older child with full head tilt; must not illustrate the infant variant. Moved to cpr from-1.
Shows a short loose bandage at the bite only — neither VN/WHO splinting nor pressure-immobilisation. Redraw: whole-limb splint (and optionally a full-length elastic bandage for the elapid case).
Two realistic newborn faces; needs clinician review of skin tones and a darker-skin example (sclera/gums).
Infant back blows: OK. Do not reuse for children ≥1 (design flag).

meta.status: DRAFT for licensed clinician review — not certified. Generated 2026-10-16.

conventions.{emergency}: Replaced by the app with the ambulance number for the family's country (see review/first-aid.md §4). Until the renderer ships, the seed script must substitute pack.emergencyNumber.
conventions.{poison}: Replaced with '<poison-centre label> <number>' for the country, or with the {emergency} number where the country has no public poison line.
conventions.replacements: Text edits at a path in the CURRENT seed (apply before structuralChanges).
conventions.structuralChanges: op=set replaces the value at path (whole steps/callouts arrays where items are added/reordered); op=append adds to an array. Apply in listed order.
